packages.name: Képes
packages.description: Photo-first look for image and video-heavy portals: a large inset hero, a masonry-like mosaic of big image cards with the headline set on a gradient, minimal chrome, generous whitespace and rounded corners. Stories without a picture become typographic cards on a tint of their category colour. A calm light scheme and a dramatic near-black dark scheme. Accent colour, logo and icons come from the active icon pack.

packages.name: Kontraszt
packages.description: Accessibility theme aiming at WCAG AAA: at least 7:1 text contrast, underlined links everywhere, thick 3 px focus rings, larger type, 44 px tap targets, clear card borders and no motion at all. Titles never sit directly on images, they get a solid band. The icon pack colour is used only for decorative borders and stripes. Black-on-white and white-on-black schemes.

packages.name: Overdrive
packages.description: Modern dark gaming theme: deep navy surfaces, a glowing accent taken from your icon pack, angled corners, a flowing gradient rail and subtle motion (staggered reveals, hover glow, shimmer buttons, reading progress bar). All animation respects reduced-motion.

packages.name: Papír
packages.description: Text-first, lightweight reading theme: listings drop their thumbnails and become calm text rows, the article page is a single comfortable column with large type and generous line height. No shadows, no animations, ideal on slow mobile connections. Warm paper-white and warm dark grey schemes.
packages.author: DDO

packages.name: Papír
packages.description: Quiet newspaper theme on warm paper: a full-width, multi-column front page whose column count grows with the screen (a two-column lead story, hairline column rules, serif small-caps section heads, a most-read column) with small, lazy-loaded black-and-white pictures between the stories. Listings flow in ruled newspaper columns, the article page spans the screen with the text in the main column beside the sidebar. Serif type, no shadows, no animations, light on slow connections. Warm paper-white and warm dark grey schemes.
packages.author: DDO

packages.name: Terminál

packages.name: Tuesday
packages.description: Hand-painted look: soft watercolour washes bleeding through the cards on grainy cold-press paper, and thick wax-crayon / dry-brush strokes with ragged, speckled edges as the decoration: painted section labels, brush-stroke category chips, crayon rules and underlines, deckled picture edges, a torn edge under the navbar and a big sweeping stroke on the listing headers and in the footer. A near-black dark scheme with lavender paint and a warm watercolour-paper light scheme; paint colour, texture strength, stroke style (brush or crayon), card corners and picture edges are adjustable. Links, buttons, logo and icons come from the active icon pack.
